items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Oh, that flutter, ain't that right there, Paul?

ctx.x: Yeah. Give us a flutter tongue. The growl. Yeah. What was that?
Oh, that flutter, ain't that right there, Paul? Flutter, ain't that ready for?

Yeah, but I mean what tune was it? Oh that wasn't no tune. You just was playing? Yeah, that wasn't no tune. That's Flutter time. I see. And what about the old time guys? What kind of deal would they do to get vibrato? Would they move that?
